heading.title: Of the Duties of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: As to deceased’s funeral.
article.content: It is the duty of an executor to provide funds for the performance of the necessary funeral ceremonies of the deceased in a manner suitable to his condition, if he has left property sufficient for the purpose.
article.html:
316As to deceased’s funeral.

Section 316 · Part IX · Chapter VII · page 84 of the Act

It is the duty of an executor to provide funds for the performance of the necessary funeral ceremonies of the deceased in a manner suitable to his condition, if he has left property sufficient for the purpose.
